traditions.LXX: Τί ὑμῖν Κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ Ἰσραήλ ?
traditions.VUL: Quid vobis et Dómino Deo Israel ?
traditions.KJV: saying , What have ye to do with the LORD God of Israel ?

25.english_reference: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you , ye children of Reuben and children of Gad

traditions.WLC: וּ גְב֣וּל נָֽתַן יְ֠הוָה בֵּינֵ֨ נוּ וּ בֵינֵי כֶ֜ם בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֤ן וּ בְנֵי גָד֙ אֶת הַ יַּרְדֵּ֔ן
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὅρια ἔθηκεν Κύριος ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμῶν τὸν Ἰορδάνην ,
traditions.VUL: Términum pósuit Dóminus inter nos et vos , o fílii Ruben , et fílii Gad , Iordánem flúvium ,
traditions.KJV: For the LORD hath made Jordan a border between us and you , ye children of Reuben and children of Gad ;

25.english_reference: ye have no part in the LORD

traditions.WLC: אֵין לָ כֶ֥ם חֵ֖לֶק בַּֽ יהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν ὑμῖν μερὶς Κυρίου ·
traditions.VUL: et idcírco partem non habétis in Dómino :
traditions.KJV: ye have no part in the LORD :

25.english_reference: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ הִשְׁבִּ֤יתוּ בְנֵי כֶם֙ אֶת בָּנֵ֔י נוּ לְ בִלְתִּ֖י יְרֹ֥א אֶת יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπαλλοτριώσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν τοὺς υἱοὺς ἡμῶν , ἵνα μὴ σέβωνται Κύριον .
traditions.VUL: et per hanc occasiónem avértent fílii vestri fílios nostros a timóre Dómini . Putávimus ítaque mélius ,
traditions.KJV: so shall your children make our children cease from fearing the LORD .

26.english_reference: Therefore we said , Let us now prepare to build us an altar

traditions.WLC: וַ נֹּ֕אמֶר נַעֲשֶׂה נָּ֣א לָ֔ נוּ לִ בְנ֖וֹת אֶת הַ מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴπαμεν ποιῆσαι οὕτως τοῦ οἰκοδομῆσαι τὸν βωμὸν τοῦτον ,
traditions.VUL: et díximus : Exstruámus nobis altáre ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore we said , Let us now prepare to build us an altar ,

26.english_reference: not for burnt offering , nor for sacrifice

traditions.WLC: לֹ֥א לְ עוֹלָ֖ה וְ לֹ֥א לְ זָֽבַח
traditions.LXX: οὐχ ἕνεκεν καρπωμάτων οὐδὲ ἕνεκεν θυσιῶν ,
traditions.VUL: non in holocáusta , neque ad víctimas offeréndas ,
traditions.KJV: not for burnt offering , nor for sacrifice :

27.english_reference: But [ that ] it [ may be ] a witness between us , and you , and our generations after us

traditions.WLC: כִּי֩ עֵ֨ד ה֜וּא בֵּינֵ֣י נוּ וּ בֵינֵי כֶ֗ם וּ בֵ֣ין דֹּרוֹתֵי נוּ֮ אַחֲרֵי נוּ֒
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἵνα ᾖ τοῦτο μαρτύριον ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν γενεῶν ἡμῶν μεθ᾽ ἡμᾶς ,
traditions.VUL: sed in testimónium inter nos et vos , et sóbolem nostram vestrámque progéniem ,
traditions.KJV: But [ that ] it [ may be ] a witness between us , and you , and our generations after us ,

27.english_reference: that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings , and with our sacrifices , and with our peace offerings

traditions.WLC: לַ עֲבֹ֞ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ לְ פָנָ֔י ו בְּ עֹלוֹתֵ֥י נוּ וּ בִ זְבָחֵ֖י נוּ וּ בִ שְׁלָמֵ֑י נוּ
traditions.LXX: τοῦ λατρεύειν λατρίαν Κυρίῳ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς καρπώμασιν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς θυσίαις ἡμῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς θυσίαις τῶν σωτηρίων ·
traditions.VUL: ut serviámus Dómino , et iuris nostri sit offérre et holocáusta , et víctimas , et pacíficas hóstias :
traditions.KJV: that we might do the service of the LORD before him with our burnt offerings , and with our sacrifices , and with our peace offerings ;

27.english_reference: that your children may not say to our children in time to come , Ye have no part in the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹא יֹאמְר֨וּ בְנֵי כֶ֤ם מָחָר֙ לְ בָנֵ֔י נוּ אֵין לָ כֶ֥ם חֵ֖לֶק בַּ יהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐροῦσιν τὰ τέκνα ὑμῶν τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν αὔριον Οὐκ ἔστιν ὑμῖν μερὶς Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: et nequáquam dicant cras fílii vestri fíliis nostris : Non est vobis pars in Dómino .
traditions.KJV: that your children may not say to our children in time to come , Ye have no part in the LORD .

28.english_reference: Therefore said we , that it shall be , when they should [ so ] say to us or to our generations in time to come

traditions.WLC: וַ נֹּ֕אמֶר וְ הָיָ֗ה כִּֽי יֹאמְר֥וּ אֵלֵ֛י נוּ וְ אֶל דֹּרֹתֵ֖י נוּ מָחָ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἴπαμεν Ἐὰν γένηταί ποτε καὶ λαλήσωσιν πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ταῖς γενεαῖς ἡμῶν αὔριον ,
traditions.VUL: Quod si volúerint dícere , respondébunt eis :
traditions.KJV: Therefore said we , that it shall be , when they should [ so ] say to us or to our generations in time to come ,

28.english_reference: that we may say [ again ] , Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD , which our fathers made

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַ֡רְנוּ רְא֣וּ אֶת תַּבְנִית֩ מִזְבַּ֨ח יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵ֗י נוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐροῦσιν Ἴδετε ὁμοίωμα τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου Κυρίου , ὃ ἐποίησαν οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν
traditions.VUL: Ecce altáre Dómini , quod fecérunt patres nostri ,
traditions.KJV: that we may say [ again ] , Behold the pattern of the altar of the LORD , which our fathers made ,

28.english_reference: not for burnt offerings , nor for sacrifices

traditions.WLC: לֹ֤א לְ עוֹלָה֙ וְ לֹ֣א לְ זֶ֔בַח
traditions.LXX: οὐχ ἕνεκεν καρπωμάτων οὐδὲ ἕνεκεν θυσιῶν ,
traditions.VUL: non in holocáusta , neque in sacrifícium ,
traditions.KJV: not for burnt offerings , nor for sacrifices ;

28.english_reference: but it [ is ] a witness between us and you

traditions.WLC: כִּי עֵ֣ד ה֔וּא בֵּינֵ֖י נוּ וּ בֵינֵי כֶֽם
traditions.LXX: ἀλλὰ μαρτύριόν ἐστιν ἀνὰ μέσον ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν υἱῶν ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: sed in testimónium nostrum ac vestrum .
traditions.KJV: but it [ is ] a witness between us and you .

29.english_reference: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD , and turn this day from following the LORD

traditions.WLC: חָלִילָ ה֩ לָּ֨ נוּ מִמֶּ֜ נּוּ לִ מְרֹ֣ד בַּֽ יהוָ֗ה וְ לָ שׁ֤וּב הַ יּוֹם֙ מֵ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: Absit a nobis hoc scelus , ut recedámus a Dómino , et eius vestígia relinquámus ,
traditions.KJV: God forbid that we should rebel against the LORD , and turn this day from following the LORD ,

29.english_reference: to build an altar for burnt offerings , for meat offerings , or for sacrifices

traditions.WLC: לִ בְנ֣וֹת מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לְ עֹלָ֖ה לְ מִנְחָ֣ה וּ לְ זָ֑בַח
traditions.VUL: exstrúcto altári ad holocáusta , et sacrifícia , et víctimas offeréndas ,
traditions.KJV: to build an altar for burnt offerings , for meat offerings , or for sacrifices ,

29.english_reference: beside the altar of the LORD our God that [ is ] before his tabernacle

traditions.WLC: מִ לְּ בַ֗ד מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י נוּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִ פְנֵ֥י מִשְׁכָּנֽ וֹ
traditions.VUL: præter altáre Dómini Dei nostri , quod exstrúctum est ante tabernáculum eius .
traditions.KJV: beside the altar of the LORD our God that [ is ] before his tabernacle .

30.english_reference: And when Phinehas the priest , and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which [ were ] with him ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁמַ֞ע פִּֽינְחָ֣ס הַ כֹּהֵ֗ן וּ נְשִׂיאֵ֨י הָ עֵדָ֜ה וְ רָאשֵׁ֨י אַלְפֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἀκούσας Φεινεὲς ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς συναγωγῆς Ἰσραὴλ οἳ ἦσαν μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ
traditions.VUL: Quibus audítis , Phínees sacérdos , et príncipes legatiónis Israel , qui erant cum eo ,
traditions.KJV: And when Phinehas the priest , and the princes of the congregation and heads of the thousands of Israel which [ were ] with him ,

30.english_reference: heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake ,

traditions.WLC: אֶת הַ֨ דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר דִּבְּר֛וּ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֥ן וּ בְנֵי גָ֖ד וּ בְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה
traditions.LXX: τοὺς λόγους οὓς ἐλάλησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ῥουβὴν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Γὰδ καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ φυλῆς Μανασσή ,
traditions.VUL: placáti sunt : et verba filiórum Ruben , et Gad , et dimídiæ tribus Manásse , libentíssime suscepérunt .
traditions.KJV: heard the words that the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh spake ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּיטַ֖ב בְּ עֵינֵי הֶֽם
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤρεσεν αὐτοῖς .
traditions.KJV: it pleased them .

31.english_reference: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben , and to the children of Gad , and to the children of Manasseh ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ כֹּהֵ֡ן אֶל בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֨ן וְ אֶל בְּנֵי גָ֜ד וְ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Φεινεὲς ὁ ἱερεὺς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ῥουβὴν καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γὰδ καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς Μανασσή
traditions.VUL: Dixítque Phínees fílius Eleázari sacérdos ad eos :
traditions.KJV: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest said unto the children of Reuben , and to the children of Gad , and to the children of Manasseh ,

31.english_reference: This day we perceive that the LORD [ is ] among us ,

traditions.WLC: הַ יּ֤וֹם יָדַ֨עְנוּ֙ כִּֽי בְ תוֹכֵ֣ נוּ יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: Σήμερον ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι μεθ᾽ ἡμῶν Κύριος ,
traditions.VUL: Nunc scimus quod nobíscum sit Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: This day we perceive that the LORD [ is ] among us ,

31.english_reference: because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD :

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא מְעַלְתֶּ֥ם בַּֽ יהוָ֖ה הַ מַּ֣עַל הַ זֶּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: διότι οὐκ ἐπλημμελήσατε ἐναντίον Κυρίου πλημμελίαν ,
traditions.VUL: quóniam aliéni estis a prævaricatióne hac ,
traditions.KJV: because ye have not committed this trespass against the LORD :

31.english_reference: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD .

traditions.WLC: אָ֗ז הִצַּלְתֶּ֛ם אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ יַּ֥ד יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὅτι ἐρύσασθε τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐκ χειρὸς Κυρίου .
traditions.VUL: et liberástis fílios Israel de manu Dómini .
traditions.KJV: now ye have delivered the children of Israel out of the hand of the LORD .

32.english_reference: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest , and the princes , returned

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֣שָׁב פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ כֹּהֵ֣ן וְ הַ נְּשִׂיאִ֡ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Φεινεὲς ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες
traditions.VUL: Reversúsque est cum princípibus
traditions.KJV: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest , and the princes , returned

32.english_reference: from the children of Reuben , and from the children of Gad ,

traditions.WLC: מֵ אֵ֣ת בְּנֵֽי רְאוּבֵן֩ וּ מֵ אֵ֨ת בְּנֵי גָ֜ד
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Ῥουβὴν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Γὰδ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσὴ
traditions.VUL: a fíliis Ruben et Gad
traditions.KJV: from the children of Reuben , and from the children of Gad ,

32.english_reference: out of the land of Gilead , unto the land of Canaan , to the children of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: מֵ אֶ֧רֶץ הַ גִּלְעָ֛ד אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ἐκ τῆς Γαλαὰδ εἰς γῆν Χανάαν πρὸς τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: de terra Gálaad , fínium Chánaan , ad fílios Israel ,
traditions.KJV: out of the land of Gilead , unto the land of Canaan , to the children of Israel ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּשִׁ֥בוּ אוֹתָ֖ ם דָּבָֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτοῖς τοὺς λόγους .
traditions.VUL: et rétulit eis .
traditions.KJV: and brought them word again .

33.english_reference: And the thing pleased the children of Israel ;

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּיטַ֣ב הַ דָּבָ֗ר בְּ עֵינֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.VUL: Placuítque sermo cunctis audiéntibus .
traditions.KJV: And the thing pleased the children of Israel ;

33.english_reference: and the children of Israel blessed God ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְבָרֲכ֥וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.VUL: Et laudavérunt Deum fílii Israel ,
traditions.KJV: and the children of Israel blessed God ,

33.english_reference: and did not intend to go up against them in battle ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹ֣א אָמְר֗וּ לַ עֲל֤וֹת עֲלֵי הֶם֙ לַ צָּבָ֔א
traditions.VUL: et nequáquam ultra dixérunt , ut ascénderent contra eos , atque pugnárent ,
traditions.KJV: and did not intend to go up against them in battle ,

33.english_reference: to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt .

traditions.WLC: לְ שַׁחֵת֙ אֶת הָ אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֥ן וּ בְנֵי גָ֖ד יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: et delérent terram possessiónis eórum .
traditions.KJV: to destroy the land wherein the children of Reuben and Gad dwelt .

34.english_reference: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar [ Ed ] :

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יִּקְרְא֛וּ בְּנֵי רְאוּבֵ֥ן וּ בְנֵי גָ֖ד לַ מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ
traditions.VUL: Vocaverúntque fílii Ruben , et fílii Gad , altáre quod exstrúxerant ,
traditions.KJV: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad called the altar [ Ed ] :

34.english_reference: for it [ shall be ] a witness between us

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י עֵ֥ד הוּא֙ בֵּֽינֹתֵ֔י נוּ
traditions.VUL: Testimónium nostrum ,
traditions.KJV: for it [ shall be ] a witness between us

traditions.WLC: כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הָ אֱלֹהִֽים
traditions.VUL: quod Dóminus ipse sit Deus .
traditions.KJV: that the LORD [ is ] God .
